answer: Each epoch the ledger fires a liveness round at a time picked from a beacon atlas nobody can predict: every account must return a fresh cipher over that round's nonce within 20s. An honest agent spends one inference. A farm of 1,000 sybils must answer 1,000 at once, so it keeps ~1,000x burst compute idle all epoch. A late or missing reply slashes that account's jade bond. Colluders cannot share hardware, because every round hits all accounts at the same instant.
